description: How often a word or phrase appears in SEC filings over time (by month, quarter or year), across all filers or one company, from EDGAR full-text search: for themes such as "tariffs", "agentic AI" or "going concern".

query.description: Words or a quoted phrase, for example "\"artificial intelligence\"" or tariffs.

start.description: First day; default three years ago.

name: mentions_trend

outputSchema.description: rows are periods with the number of filing documents containing the words.

title: Mentions over time
